title: Novade Defect Lodging & Photo Best Practice
content: Defects must be logged item-by-item through the developer's Novade app. Best practice: take 1 wide-angle photo showing the entire wall/area for context, and 1 close-up macro photo with blue masking tape clearly marking the defect. This avoids contractors rejecting tickets for 'location unclear' or 'cannot identify'.

title: Joint Inspection Scheduling Workflow
content: Once all defect items are lodged on Novade, contact the Lentor Modern customer service representative assigned during key collection to schedule a joint inspection walkthrough with the CS officer and main contractor (Lian Beng Construction) teams.

title: Contractor Access During Rectification
content: Homeowners do not need to be physically present during ongoing defect rectifications. The developer's contractors will access the unit across consecutive working days to complete rectifications (which typically take up to 30 days under the Building Defect Liability Period) before a final joint sign-off walkthrough.

title: Complimentary 7-Day Utilities Grace Period
content: GuocoLand provides a complimentary 7-day grace period of water and electricity immediately following key handover. Use this window to test all electrical sockets, SMEG appliances, aircon blowers, and plumbing/drainage before activating your personal SP Services utilities account.

title: Handover to Move-In Timeline Planning
content: When planning your transition and lease dates, budget approximately 3 to 4 weeks for comprehensive defect checking and contractor rectifications, followed by 4 to 6 weeks for interior design/renovation works, plus 1 to 2 weeks for cleaning and moving.

title: Critical Technical Inspection Checks Beyond Cosmetics
content: In addition to cosmetic paint or joint sealant checks, test technical items: (1) RJ45 data/ethernet wall ports in all bedrooms, (2) hollow tiles across living and bedroom floors using a tapping rod, and (3) floor gradient test in both master and common bathrooms (water should drain smoothly without ponding).

title: No-Neutral Smart Light Switch Wiring
content: The lighting switches in Lentor Modern units are wired WITHOUT a neutral wire. If converting to smart switches (Aqara, Tuya, etc.), ensure you purchase 'No-Neutral' switch models or install compatible bypass capacitors at the ceiling light fittings.

title: Smart Home Hub & Motorised Blinds Integration
content: The developer provides a central smart home gateway for unit controls. This hub links to mobile apps for home access and can be integrated with Dooya-compatible RF motors commonly used by local zip-blind vendors for automated outdoor balcony blind control.

title: Dishwasher Space & Tabletop Solutions
content: Built-in under-counter cabinetry space is not pre-plumbed for standard 60cm full-size dishwashers in most layouts. Residents looking for dishwashing convenience often opt for compact tabletop dishwashers or consult their interior designer for carpentry/plumbing modifications.

title: Window Solar Film to Reduce Aircon Cooling Load
content: For units receiving afternoon sun exposure, installing UV and high-heat-blocking solar film on windows significantly mitigates indoor heat accumulation and reduces daily operating load on the Mitsubishi air conditioning units.

title: SMEG Induction Hob 'L' Code Unlock
content: When code 'L' appears on your SMEG induction cooktop display, the Child Controls Lock is engaged. With at least one zone powered, press and hold the Key Symbol button continuously for 1 to 2 seconds until the LED indicator turns off.

title: Yale Digital Lock Emergency 9V Jumpstart
content: If the AA batteries in your Yale main door digital lock (YDM7116A) are completely drained, touch a standard rectangular 9V alkaline battery firmly against the two external contact pins located at the bottom of the front keypad. Hold it in place while entering your PIN or tapping your RFID card.

title: Aircon SWG 22 Copper Piping Specifications
content: When engaging third-party contractors for air conditioning servicing, piping alterations, or unit shifts, strictly verify that they use SWG 22 (0.71mm wall thickness) copper pipes as specified by GuocoLand to avoid voiding the developer's building warranty.

title: Food Delivery & Courier Routing (Level 2 Intercom, 3.0m Limit)
content: The Level 1 ground lobby intercom is intentionally disabled by estate management to prevent lobby congestion. Food delivery riders (Grab, Foodpanda, ShopeeFood) and parcel couriers must drive up the carpark ramp to Level 2 to access the tower intercom and buzz your unit. Note: The Level 2 ramp has a 3.0-meter vehicle height clearance limit.

title: Heavy Moving Lorries & Bulky Deliveries Bay (Residential Ramp, 3.8m Limit)
content: Heavy furniture trucks, large appliance deliveries, and moving lorries must NOT use the Level 2 ramp. Instead, enter via the dedicated Residential Loading & Unloading Bay ramp on Lentor Central, which accommodates vehicles up to 3.8m in height. Submit Form 2.1 to the Estate Office in advance during permitted moving hours.

title: Granting Lift Access via iPlus Living App
content: Delivery riders must key in your unit number at the intercom panel. Buzz them in through the iPlus Living app or your indoor monitor. This authorizes the lift to take them directly to your floor. Note: Riders who tailgate others into the lift without being buzzed in will not have authorization to press your floor button.

title: Lift Access Card Tapping 2-Second Delay Workaround
content: If your floor button fails to register or turns off after tapping your access card in the lift, introduce a brief pause. Wait 1 to 2 seconds after the card reader beeps before pressing your floor button to allow the lift system enough time to register the authorization.

title: Canceling Accidental Lift Floor Selections
content: If you or a visitor accidentally presses the wrong floor button inside the residential lift car, quickly double-tap (press twice) the illuminated floor button to deselect and cancel that stop.

title: Fiber Broadband Riser Key for Internet Setup
content: Telco technicians (Singtel, StarHub, M1, Simba, MyRepublic) installing broadband require access to the telecom riser on your floor. Collect the Telecom Riser Key from the 24/7 Security Guardhouse ~15 minutes before your technician arrives, and return it immediately after installation.

title: Permitted House Moving and Bulky Delivery Hours
content: Bulky deliveries and move-in activities are restricted under MCST Form 2.1 to: Mondays to Fridays: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.; Saturdays: 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. No moving or bulky deliveries are permitted on Sundays or Public Holidays to ensure quiet enjoyment for neighbours.

title: Balcony Zip Blinds Approved Specs & Color Uniformity
content: Balcony zip track blinds are permitted but must strictly adhere to GuocoLand/MCST uniform façade guidelines: dark grey / charcoal perforated screen fabric. Non-approved colors or unapproved external additions will fail final inspection and cause forfeiture of your renovation deposit.

title: Balcony Half-Height Wall Blind Measurements
content: Certain unit stacks feature a half-height concrete wall on one side of the balcony. Inform your zip-blind vendor to measure both sides separately, as one panel will require a shorter drop height to fit above the half-wall ledge.

title: Balcony Invisible Grille Installation Guidelines
content: Installation of invisible grilles at the balcony and open windows is permitted for child and pet safety. Ensure cables are installed according to MCST uniform spacing guidelines and do not protrude beyond the approved building perimeter line.

title: Official Unit Paint Codes (Internal Walls & External Façade)
content:
Verified developer paint specifications for Lentor Modern:
• Internal Walls & Ceilings: Intermatt BS E55 (White).
• Balcony & External Façade: Dulux (ICI) 'Thick Smoke' — Colour Code: 96YR 09/033 (Composilicon W55).
Provide these exact codes to your contractor or painter for seamless touch-ups that comply with MCST façade appearance by-laws.

title: Function Room Amenities & Billiard Table
content: The condominium's function room is equipped with a full-sized billiard/pool table, lounge seating, and dining facilities. Residents can book the function room via the iPlus Living app subject to MCST booking quotas and refundable deposit terms.

title: Mall Operating Status & Key Anchor Tenants
content: Lentor Modern Mall is fully open with 53 retail, F&B, medical, and wellness outlets. Key anchors include CS Fresh supermarket at B1 (#B1-11 to #B1-16), Mulberry Learning @ Lentor preschool & childcare at Level 2 (#02-01), Pinnacle Family Clinic (#01-44), and Minmed Clinic (#01-16/17).

title: CS Fresh Daily 8:30 PM Grocery Discounts
content: CS Fresh supermarket at Basement 1 regularly marks down freshly prepared sushi, bento meals, cooked deli meats, and fresh bakery items by 20% to 30% daily starting from 8:30 PM onwards.

title: ResiQ Resident Queue & Order Ahead Web App
content: Residents can use the community-built ResiQ web app (https://resiq-lm.vercel.app/) to skip queues and order ahead at Lentor Modern Mall merchants. Includes digital queue ticket links (e.g. QB Premium haircuts), direct mobile order links for F&B (Ajumma's, Yuen Kee Dumpling, Omoté, Umai Udon, A Hot Hideout, KFC, Burger King), and a directory of 31 exclusive resident discounts.

title: Mall Parking Rates, 10-Min Grace Period & EV Charging
content: Lentor Modern Mall public parking promotional rate (till 31 Dec 2026) is $1.20 for 1st hour, then $0.50/30mins all day. Important: There is a 10-minute complimentary grace period—perfect for delivery drivers or quick takeaway pick-ups without paying parking. EV chargers are at B1 (Lots 39–42).

title: Resident Access Card Mall Discounts (31 Merchants)
content: Remember to flash your physical Lentor Modern Resident Access Card before payment to enjoy exclusive discounts across 31 mall merchants till 31 Dec 2026. Top perks: $3 off haircuts at QB Premium (#01-45), 10% off at Yuen Kee Dumpling & The Hanok, 10% off Burger King, 15% off KFC & Tim Hortons ($15 min), and free Hotteok at Ajumma's ($45 min spend).

title: Visitor Pedestrian Access from MRT & Taxi Stand
content: Visitors arriving via MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line TE5, Exit 1) or taxi should use the main sheltered entrance near Burger King (#01-14/15) and the mall central atrium, which serves as the most convenient meeting point before heading to residential tower lift lobbies.

title: Gym Operating Hours & 10 PM Automated Cutoff
content: The Level 4 Clubhouse Gym opens from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily (revised from the initial 8:00 AM opening after resident feedback to the concierge). Note that it is NOT a 24-hour facility: access is automated, so your card will not unlock the door before 6:00 AM or after 10:00 PM, and lights/aircon turn off automatically at 10:00 PM sharp. Free weights (dumbbells up to 40kg), lockers, towels, and a water dispenser are provided.

title: Shopee / SPX Parcel Lockers (Carpark Level 2, Residents Only)
content: Shopee / SPX automated parcel collection lockers are located at Carpark Level 2 near Tower 5 and the letterbox area. These lockers are in active operation and exclusively available to Lentor Modern residents for self-collection via the Shopee app.

title: Shopee Collection Point at Twigly's Convenience Store (#01-10)
content: Twigly's Convenience Store (#01-10) at Lentor Modern Mall serves as an official Shopee collection point. Residents can choose Twigly's as their pickup location during Shopee checkout for parcel collection downstairs.

title: Visitor Directions via MRT (Lentor TE5 Exit 1 -> Level 4 Clubhouse -> Residential Towers)
content: For guests visiting Lentor Modern by train: (1) Alight at Lentor MRT Station (Thomson-East Coast Line TE5) and proceed out via Exit 1. (2) At the top of the escalator, turn right, go down the short flight of stairs, and turn left. (3) Walk past Burger King (#01-14/15) along the sheltered walkway—the Residential Clubhouse entrance is located right beside Ma Kuang TCM (#01-12) and Fresh & Clean. (4) Ring the Concierge buzzer at the entrance door for the concierge to grant access to the Clubhouse lift. (5) Take the lift up to Level 4. (6) At Level 4, inform the Concierge desk which unit and tower you are visiting. (7) Walk straight out of the concierge lobby onto the sky deck: for Tower 5, turn left, cross the small bridge (no need to walk along the pool), and turn right to reach the Tower 5 lift lobby; for Towers 3 and 7, follow the directional signage across the landscape deck. (8) At the tower lift lobby intercom, dial the resident's unit number (#XX-YY) so the resident can buzz you into the lift and activate your floor button.

title: Visitor Driving & Private Hire (Grab / Gojek / Taxi) Navigation & Mall Drop-off Pitfall
content: For guests or private hire drivers visiting Lentor Modern by car: (1) Set GPS destination directly to the specific residential tower (e.g., 'Lentor Modern Tower 3', 'Tower 5', or 'Tower 7'). (2) CRITICAL DRIVER WARNING: Google Maps and GPS apps frequently direct drivers into the Lentor Modern Mall commercial retail drop-off lane by mistake. Before the vehicle turns into the mall drop-off, ensure the driver stays to the left lane to enter the Residents' Carpark ramp entrance located immediately before the mall drop-off. (3) Inform the security guard at the barrier that you are visiting a resident at Tower 3, 5, or 7. (4) Proceed up the carpark ramp to Level 2 or Level 3 visitor parking / tower drop-off. (5) Walk directly to the respective tower lift lobby and dial the host's unit number (#XX-YY) on the intercom panel to be granted lift access to their floor.
